name: io.github.p9m-team/p9m
title: Purgatorium (p9m)
description: Self-hosted Docker sandboxes for agents: create one, deploy a compose stack, read its files and URLs

purgatorium_host.description: Your Purgatorium server's address, where its UI is (PUBLIC_URL without https://), e.g. p9m.example.com

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>: a Purgatorium access token (Access tokens page); a token limited to one sandbox gets only that sandbox's tools
